editions.blurb: Modern Vanilla+ with animated mobs, Iris shaders and overhauled villages.
The lighter, faster-era survival setup for older machines and servers.

items.title: Fabric API
items.blurb: The hooks every other Fabric mod needs.

items.title: Sodium
items.blurb: A rewritten chunk renderer: several times the frame rate of vanilla.

items.title: Iris Shaders
items.blurb: Loads shader packs without OptiFine, and works with Sodium.

items.title: Indium
items.blurb: Fabric rendering API on top of Sodium, for mods like Continuity.

items.title: MidnightLib
items.blurb: The small library Repurposed Structures needs to start; Modrinth doesn't list it as a dependency.

items.title: Lithium
items.blurb: Speeds up the server-side game logic: ticks, AI and physics.

items.title: FerriteCore
items.blurb: Cuts the game's memory use, which leaves more room for shaders.

items.title: Krypton
items.blurb: Optimises multiplayer networking for lower, steadier ping.

items.title: Mod Menu
items.blurb: Lists installed mods in game and opens their settings.

items.title: Entity Model Features
items.blurb: Plays Fresh Animations-style mob models on Fabric, no OptiFine needed.

items.title: Entity Texture Features
items.blurb: Random and emissive mob textures, and the eyes that glow at night.

items.title: Not Enough Animations
items.blurb: Third-person player animation: eating, climbing, rowing, map holding.

items.title: Eating Animation
items.blurb: Food is actually bitten into while you eat.

items.title: First-person Model
items.blurb: Shows your body in first person, so armor and animations read in view.

items.title: playerAnimator
items.blurb: Player animation library used by the animation mods above.

items.title: Hold My Items
items.blurb: Animated first-person hands that actually hold the item, with swing and mining motion.
items.note: Replaces First Person Model: running both draws a second pair of arms, so remove that one first.

items.title: Continuity
items.blurb: Connected glass and blocks, the way OptiFine did it.

items.title: Fresh Animations
items.blurb: Living mob animation: neutral and hostile mobs that move like creatures.
items.note: On 1.16.5 this pack needs OptiFine; the 1.20.1 setup plays it through Entity Model Features.

items.title: Fresh Animations: Player Extension
items.blurb: Fresh Animations' own player pack: walking, idle and item animations on your body.
items.note: Needs Fresh Animations plus Entity Model and Entity Texture Features, which this edition already installs.

items.title: Actually 3D Blocks & Items!
items.blurb: Vanilla-style 3D models for tools, food and blocks, including held-item shapes.
items.note: The newer 'Actually 3D Stuff' pack starts at 1.21.9, so 1.20.1 gets this build from the same author.

items.title: Better Villages
items.blurb: Bigger, denser villages with furnished houses and far more loot.

items.title: Eugene's Wealthy Plains Village
items.blurb: A wealthy plains village variant with a stacked, lootable blacksmith.

items.title: When Dungeons Arise
items.blurb: Huge, dangerous structures to find and clear out while exploring.

items.title: Repurposed Structures
items.blurb: More village and structure variants for every biome.

items.title: ChoiceTheorem's Overhauled Village
items.blurb: Hand-built village overhauls that fit each biome's style.

items.title: Towns and Towers
items.blurb: New villages, towers and outposts that feel built, not generated.

items.title: AppleSkin
items.blurb: Shows hunger and saturation restored before you eat.

items.title: Just Enough Items
items.blurb: Every recipe in the game, searchable in your inventory.

items.title: Shulker Box Tooltip
items.blurb: Peek inside a shulker box without placing it.

items.title: BetterF3
items.blurb: A readable, coloured debug screen.

items.title: RightClickHarvest
items.blurb: Harvest and replant farms with a right click.

items.title: Complementary Reimagined
items.blurb: The all-rounder: soft light, water and weather at a fair frame cost.

items.title: BSL Shaders
items.blurb: Painterly, warm lighting with strong clouds and god rays.

items.title: MakeUp - Ultra Fast
items.blurb: Shader looks on integrated graphics: waves, sun and coloured light.

items.title: Photon Shader
items.blurb: Ray-traced-feeling shadows and atmosphere for a darker survival mood.
